visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black long-sleeved athletic top with a logo on the chest, stands in a brightly lit indoor room with cream-colored walls. She looks thoughtfully toward the side before turning to the camera, touching her cheek and jawline with her right hand while smiling slightly. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a clear pump bottle containing a transparent liquid. A hand presses the black pump, dispensing the liquid onto the palm of another hand against a white-tiled bathroom background with bright, flat lighting. (3) The woman, now in a bathroom wearing a white headband with animal ears, applies a white lather to her face. She uses a pink, circular electronic facial cleansing device to massage her cheeks and nose in circular motions while looking into the camera. (4) In the previous room setting, the woman holds a frosted glass bottle with a yellow liquid. She sprays the liquid onto her face several times with her eyes closed, then uses both hands to gently pat her cheeks and forehead. (5) A close-up shows a white cream jar labeled 'SIMPLE CARE' being opened. The woman takes a small amount of white cream on her finger, dabbing it onto her hand and then onto her forehead, massaging it in while looking at the camera. (6) The woman leans her chin on her arms atop a white table, smiling warmly at the camera. In front of her are the four skincare products and the pink brush, positioned next to a large vanity mirror with multiple bright bulbs.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 最近我換了一整組保養. (2) [Subtitle]: 發現原來保養不需要很複雜. (3) [Subtitle]: 對的方法3步就有感. (4) [Subtitle]: 這瓶積雪草保濕舒緩洗卸露我超驚艷. [Logo]: SIMPLE CARE. (5) [Subtitle]: 是洗卸二合一. (6) [Subtitle]: 搭配矽膠潔顏儀. (7) [Subtitle]: 每次洗完都覺得毛孔很乾淨. (8) [Subtitle]: 但完全不乾繃. (9) [Subtitle]: 臉摸起來滑滑嫩嫩的. (10) [Subtitle]: 接著這瓶是密羅木煥顏肌底油水精華. [Logo]: SIMPLE CARE. (11) [Subtitle]: 它是2:8的油水比例. (12) [Subtitle]: 吸收的超快. (13) [Subtitle]: 用了幾天我覺得肌膚明顯比較透亮. (14) [Subtitle]: 也比較不容易乾癢脫皮. (15) [Subtitle]: 最後這瓶是密羅木胜肽緊緻賦活霜. [Logo]: SIMPLE CARE. (16) [Subtitle]: 保濕力很強但不悶黏. (17) [Subtitle]: 而且裡面有胜肽和Q10會讓肌膚有彈性. (18) [Subtitle]: 整個穩定很多. (19) [Subtitle]: 如果你跟我一樣是忙碌又愛護膚的人. (20) [Subtitle]: 這組simple care保養我真的會回購. [Logo]: SIMPLE CARE. (21) [Subtitle]: 3步驟讓保養變得很簡單也很有效.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long straight black hair, wearing a black athletic top and later a white animal-ear headband during her skincare routine.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A neutral indoor room with a plain wall and a white table, and a clean bathroom with white tiles and a vanity mirror with round lights.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins speaking with high energy and a friendly, engaging tone over an upbeat electronic pop background music track. The BGM features bright synth chords and a persistent 4/4 electronic drum beat. (2) A quick, airy 'hiss' sound effect repeats twice as the skincare spray is applied, which stands out clearly against the consistent BGM loop. The speaker maintains her enthusiastic prosody, emphasizing key product names. (3) Soft mechanical clicks are audible as product jars are opened and closed. The music continues at a steady volume, perfectly balanced with the clear, studio-quality narration. The voice reaches a final positive resolution as the BGM fades out slightly at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and endorse the 'SIMPLE CARE' skincare line by demonstrating its ease of use and effectiveness in a simple 3-step routine.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker explicitly mentions the brand name 'SIMPLE CARE', uses their products exclusively, and recommends them for repurchase.
